title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (23,935 affected)
summary: THE HEATER CONTROL VALVE STEM DOES NOT MEET THE MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS. HIGH COOLANT TEMPERATURES CAN CAUSE THE STEM TO LEAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS AND PUMP (26,700 affected)
summary: THE FUEL SUPPLY, RETURN AND VAPOR HOSES OR LINES CAN CONTACT OR HAVE INADEQUATE CLEARANCE WITH THE SURROUNDING COMPONENTS DUE TO IMPROPER POSITIONING DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (3,493 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AND/OR REAR TANK MOUNTING STRAPS CAN CRACK OR BREAK.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (3,037 affected)
summary: THE FUEL LINES ATTACHED TO THE FUEL TANK WERE NOT PROPERLY TIGHTENED.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE:STEER (206 affected)
summary: THE RIGHT HAND SPINDLE NUT WAS NOT PROPERLY TIGHTENED DURING ASSEMBLY. THIS CAN CAUSE PREMATURE WHEEL BEARING FAILURE AND OVER TIME, THE SPINDLE CAN FRACTURE.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS (1,997 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH LIGHTING CONTROL MODULES WHICH CAN EXPERIENCE EXCESSIVE CURRENT LEAKAGE DUE TO DAMAGED SURFACE MOUNTING CAPACITORS. THIS CAN CAUSE LOSS OF HEAD LAMPS AND PARKING LAMPS.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (131 affected)
summary: THROTTLE SENSOR ROD CAN SEPARATE FROM BALL STUD DUE TO EXCESSIVE WEARING OF ROD-END INTERNAL SURFACES.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (324 affected)
summary: INTERFERENCE OF THE "DRAG LINK" WITH AN ADJUSTING SCREW OF THE LEFT DISC BRAKE SLACK ADJUSTER COULD OCCUR WHEN EXTREME SUSPENSION MOVEMENT IS COMBINED WITH MAXIMUM STEERING ANGLE.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (200 affected)
summary: A SERVICE BRAKE HOSE AND A SPRING BRAKE HOSE ARE NOT OF SUFFICIENT LENGTHS WHICH COULD CAUSE ONE OR BOTH HOSES TO SEPARATE FROM THE END FITTINGS DURING FULL ARTICULATION.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: WHEELS (97,000 affected)
summary: THE ALUMINUM WHEELS WERE CLEAR COATED SEVERAL TIMES TO PROTECT THE METAL FINISH. SOME EXCESSIVE COATING CAN LEAVE THE WHEEL NUTS AN EXCESSIVE DISTANCE FROM THE WHEEL HUB WHEN TIGHTENED, ALLOWING THEM TO LOOSEN OVER TIME.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:JACKS (72 affected)
summary: THE LEVELING JACK HYDRAULIC HOSE LINES ARE ROUTED CLOSE TO THE ENGINE EXHAUST MANIFOLD. THIS CAN CAUSE THE HOSE TO MELT AND RESULT IN A HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK ONTO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL (6,449 affected)
summary: THE BASE OF THE ELECTRONIC ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS MADE OF DIE CAST ALUMINUM. THE BASE MOUNTS DIRECTLY TO THE CAB FIREWALL. THE CAB FIREWALL IS NOT RIGID ENOUGH OR FLAT ENOUGH AT THE MOUNTING SURFACE, CAUSING STRESS ON THE ACCELERATOR BASE THAT WILL CAUSE THE MOUNTING PADS ON THE BASE OF THE PEDAL ASSEMBLY TO FAIL AND TOTALLY SEPARATE FROM THE FIREWALL.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:LINKAGES (321 affected)
summary: THE STEERING ARM CAN DEVELOP CRACKS CAUSING THE LEVER TO BREAK WITHOUT WARNING.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES (1,500 affected)
summary: THE RETAINER CLIP WHICH HOLDS THE MASTER CYLINDER PUSH ROD TO THE BRAKE PEDAL ARM IS MISSING OR NOT COMPLETELY INSTALLED. THE PUSH ROD CAN SEPARATE FROM THE BRAKE PEDAL ARM.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:PASSENG (29,000 affected)
summary: TWO BOLTS THAT ATTACH THE PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM MODULE TO THE INSTRUMENT PANEL ARE MISSING. IN THE EVENT OF A FRONTAL IMPACT, THE MODULE CAN COME OUT OF THE INSTRUMENT PANEL.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY (403,273 affected)
summary: THE UPPER TRANSAXLE OIL COOLER HOSE CAN PULL OUT OF THE CRIMPED COUPLING AT THE TRANSAXLE END OF THE LINE ASSEMBLY.

title: COBRA INDUSTRIES, INC.: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BRAKE LIGHTS (819 affected)
summary: THE ANGLE OF THE REAR COMBINATION LAMP IS NOT WITHIN THE PROPER SPECIFICATIONS FOR FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: MORGAN OLSON: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (7,256 affected)
summary: A 2" BALL WAS TO BE WELDED TO A STEEL BAR AS WELL AS THE NUT FOR THE BALL WELDED TO THE SHANK. SOME VEHICLES WERE NOT PROPERLY WELDED ALLOWING THE NUT TO COME OFF.

title: GRANNING AIR SUSPENSIONS: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER (114 affected)
summary: IF THE BOLT IS INSTALLED WITH THE THREAD PORTION OF THE BOLT TOWARD THE WHEEL, THE DISTANCE BETWEEN THE THREADED PORTION OF THE BOLT AND THE CALIPER HOUSING IS NOT SUFFICIENT. THE BOLT WILL COME IN CONTACT WITH THE CALIPER CAUSING THE BRAKE PAD TO SEPARATE FROM THE BRAKE ROTOR.

title: IC CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (566 affected)
summary: AN INCOMPLETE TIRE SIZE WAS LISTED ON THE CERTIFICATION LABEL. ALSO, THE RIM SIZE LISTED ON THE CERTIFICATION LABEL INCLUDED ONLY THE WIDTH AND NOT THE WIDTH AND DIAMETER AS REQUIRED. THESE VEHICLES DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."

title: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (34 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC THROTTLE CHAIN CAN CATCH ON THE THROTTLE LINKAGE, CAUSING THE THROTTLE TO REMAIN OPEN.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (1,500 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SUSPENSION TRACK BAR BRACKET ATTACHMENT HAS INADEQUATE FATIGUE STRENGTH AND CAN FAIL, CAUSING FRONT AXLE VIBRATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (28,500 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK FILLER PIPE OPENING REINFORCEMENT CAN LEAK AT THE WELD.

title: Jayco, Inc.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (1,045 affected)
summary: THE AXLE ARM CONTACTS THE REAR AXLE MOUNTING BOLT HEAD.

title: HORTON EMERGENCY VEHICLES: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (400 affected)
summary: FATIGUE CRACKS APPEAR AROUND THE MOUNTING BOLTS IN THE BASE PLATE OF THE DRYER ASSEMBLY.

title: TRACKER MARINE L.P.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (68 affected)
summary: THESE TRAILERS ARE EQUIPPED WITH A "SWING-AWAY" TONGUE THAT FOLDS INTO A 90 DEGREE ANGLE WHEN IN STORAGE. THE HOLES USED FOR THE FASTENERS ARE LARGER THAN NEEDED, CAUSING A LOADED TRAILER TO WEAVE UNSAFELY.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:GEAR BOX (204 affected)
summary: THE STEERING GEARBOX MOUNTING FASTENERS WERE NOT PROPERLY HEAT TREATED.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (130,581 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK ATTACHMENT STRAP FASTENERS WERE NOT PROPERLY TIGHTENED. THE FASTENERS CAN COMPLETELY DETACH, EVENTUALLY ALLOWING THE FUEL TANK TO SAG AND THE BOTTOM OF THE TANK TO STRIKE THE ROADWAY.

title: TIARA MOTOR COACH DIVISION: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (2,419 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT LENGTH DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS TO FIT A 95TH PERCENTILE DUMMY IN THE DRIVER'S SEAT POSITION IF THE SEAT IS IN FULL FORWARD POSITION. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (70,676 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE LINES CAN CONTACT THE TRANSMISSION MOUNTING BRACKET OF THE FRAME SIDE RAIL. THE LINES CAN WEAR THROUGH RESULTING IN LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID, AND EVENTUAL LOSS OF HALF THE VEHICLE BRAKING SYSTEM.

title: General Motors, LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD (29 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELDS WERE INSTALLED WITH INCORRECT WINDSHIELD OPENING PINCH-WELD-FLANGE PRIMER. THIS PRIMER WILL NOT PROPERLY ETCH THE PAINTED SURFACE OF THE FLANGE, ALLOWING THE WINDSHIELD TO SEPARATE FROM THE VEHICLE DURING A COLLISION. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 212, "WINDSHIELD MOUNTING."

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM (435 affected)
summary: THE REAR BRAKE DRUMS WERE NOT CORRECTLY MACHINED. AS THE VEHICLE IS DRIVEN, LOSS OF WHEEL CLAMP LOAD CAN RESULT FROM THIS CONDITION. ONCE CLAMP LOAD IS LOST, ALL TIRE LOADS ARE DIRECTLY TAKEN BY THE WHEEL STUDS. THIS LOADING CAN CAUSE FATIGUE FAILURE OF THE WHEEL STUDS.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES:BEAD (76,699 affected)
summary: AN INSUFFICIENT CURE CONDITION IN THE BEAD WIRE RUBBER INSULATION WAS CAUSED BY A SMALL AMOUNT OF CONTAMINATED RUBBER.

title: IC CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE:BEARING (3,421 affected)
summary: THE REAR AXLE BEARING LOCKING WASHER WAS NOT ASSEMBLED WITH A TAB BENT OVER THE JAM NUT. THE JAM NUT CAN LOOSEN ALLOWING THE BEARING ADJUSTING NUT TO LOOSEN.

title: Mazda North American Operations: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL (48,609 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE CONTROL SELF-ADJUST PAWL DOES NOT LINE UP PROPERLY WITH THE SELF-ADJUST RACHET CAUSING THE PAWL TO SLIP OVER ONE OR MORE TEETH IN THE RACHET.

title: SHOW TRUCKS USA, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART (68 affected)
summary: THE "BATTERY BUDDY" SYSTEM IS DESIGNED TO LIMIT THE AMOUNT OF RESERVE BATTERY POWER. INSTALLATION IN THESE CONVERSION VANS CAN CAUSE THE BATTERY TO SHORT AT ANY TIME.

title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER AND PLATE (297 affected)
summary: THE RIM SIZE, GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING, AND GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING ON THESE TRANSIT BUSES ARE INCORRECT. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF PART 567, "CERTIFICATION."
